text:
maya: Quick design sync on the routing 3priority ladder4 panel. Seen with big rule sets its hard to scan and the reorder affordances feel fiddly. Sharing observations + quick asks.

jordan: Nice callout. High-level: visual density, drag affordance visibility, keyboard reorder accessibility, and validation tone.

sam: Copy: the current 'Invalid rule' and 'Error: no match' labels are too alarm-y. Propose 'Potential conflict' or 'No rules matched the preview' with actionable hints (e.g., 'Try relaxing condition X').

taylor: Simulator control location: its tucked right now. People expect it next to the preview title. Can we colocate it and add a tiny live vs one-shot switch? Also add a small run history dropdown.

lee: Accessibility: drag handle icon contrast measures ~2.2:1 against white. Need >=4.5:1. Suggest either darker icon (#4b5256) or visible focus ring. Keyboard reorder pattern: Space to pick, arrows to move, Enter/Space to drop. Add `aria-grabbed` while moving and `aria-describedby` with short instructions.

maya: @lee can you paste a tiny CSS snippet we can drop in the PR?

lee: sure:
```css
.rule-row__handle { color: #4b5256; }
.rule-row__handle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0A84FF; outline-offset: 2px; }
```

noah-bot: Accessibility checklist created: A11Y-PRIORITY-412 (contrast + keyboard reorder + live region).

jordan: Tie-breaker visibility: when two rules share the same priority, show a subtle 3tie4 chevron with tooltip showing created-at and rule-id. Make it optional in advanced view.

sam: For conflicts, instead of blocking the user show a 'View conflict' inline button that focuses the other rule and opens a small diff tooltip detailing the overlapping conditions. Focus should move to the conflicting rule and be announced.

taylor: UX for long conditions: currently we truncate. Suggest inline wrapping with a subtle gradient fade and a hover-to-expand affordance so scanning doesn't require opening every rule. Also show a compact snackbar when copy is long to allow quick copy-to-clipboard.

maya: Regarding density modes could we offer 'Compact ladder' and 'Comfortable ladder' toggles in the panel toolbar? Default to compact when >8 rules are present. Show the sticky priority column in both modes.

jordan: Microinteraction: when dragging show a 3ghost placeholder4 with slightly elevated shadow and `aria-hidden=true`, and announce 3Moving rule X to position Y4 via polite live region. When drop completes, focus the moved rule and announce completion.

lee: Add `aria-live=\"polite\"` on preview and on the reorder announcement region. Also ensure reduced-motion preference respects any drag animations.

sam: Validation copy doc: I'll prepare suggested phrases and severity levels — e.g., info (no match), warning (potential conflict), error (mutually exclusive condition).

taylor: Small layout request: make the priority numbers column sticky with subtle divider and ensure it doesn't overlap responsive widths. If pinned, allow resizing the rules column.

maya: I'll prototype three things: compact vs comfortable rows, sticky priority column with tie-breaker tooltip, and a keyboard reorder HTML demo (Space + arrows). ETA: Thursday midday.

jordan: Action items: Maya  prototypes + demo; Lee  update A11Y-PRIORITY-412 with contrast targets + test steps; Sam  validation copy doc + 'View conflict' interactions; Taylor  move simulator control and add run-history UI; I'll set a 30-min review slot Friday.

noah-bot: Linked design PR #2042 and A11Y-PRIORITY-412 to this thread.

maya: Thanks all  I'll post mocks and a tiny HTML sandbox. Please comment on the keyboard focus flow and copy first.

jordan: Please include focus states, reduced-motion, and contrast variants in the mock to speed signoff. :thumbsup:
